# S49 — Fall back to the next matrix row on a rate limit or error

Owner 2026-10-20: when Codex is rate-limited or fails, the engine should fall back to the Claude row (matrix: Sol high then Sonnet medium). By hand, relay-call.sh falls back on a rate limit and the orchestrator picks the next row on an implementer error; the engine must do both. Depends on the Codex adapter.
